question: What restaurant can I find within 80 kilometers ahead of Latvian Cultural Garden, Cleveland, OH toward Blue Hen Falls Trailhead, Brecksville, OH?
sql:
WITH
    angle AS (SELECT degrees(ST_Azimuth(ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-81.626843 41.526119)',4326)::geography, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-81.572582 41.256432)',4326)::geography)) AS value)
SELECT * FROM pois,angle
WHERE amenity = 'restaurant'
AND ST_DWithin(pois.geometry, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-81.626843 41.526119)',4326)::geography, 80000)
AND (degrees(ST_Azimuth(ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-81.626843 41.526119)',4326)::geography, pois.geometry)) BETWEEN angle.value - 22.5 AND angle.value + 22.5);

answers.poi_name: Big Eye Japanese Cuisine and Sushi Bar

[4].display_name: Blue Hen Falls Trailhead, Brecksville, OH
